description:
Aircraft Survivability Equipment Software Developer The Opportunity:  
 Aircraft survivability equipment and countermeasures systems are critical technologies that provide the last line of defense for U.S. and allied pilots flying missions in harm’s way. Booz Allen needs your skills and dedication to protecting our military aviators through the sustainment and technical support to today's fielded systems, as well as performing research and development of next generation aircraft countermeasures systems and capabilities. You will play an integral role in designing, developing, testing, and fielding the complex hardware and software involved to deliver exceptional battlefield overmatch.

 In this role, you will apply your skills in software development, software-hardware interactions, test equipment programming, and hardware emulation and develop expertise in how these technologies interact to deliver critical defense system capabilities. You will work in a Government test facility to perform hands-on sustainment of currently fielded aircraft survivability equipment, including the air countermeasures dispensing system and its associated software, hardware, and test fixtures. You will develop software, configure hardware, and perform testing to confirm system performance.

 In this role you will provide software development, test equipment design, and support to fielded system operators of the ALE-47 Countermeasures Dispensing System and its associated test software and hardware. You will interact with US and Allied operators, troubleshoot production or test system issues, and develop improvements that meet their needs.

 Join us. The world can’t wait.

 You Have: 

 10+ years of experience performing software development and hardware testing of fielded and in-production U.S military systems such as avionics systems, control systems, or countermeasures dispensing systems
 10+ years of experience in software and firmware programming languages such as C, C++, 8051 Assembly, Python, or ADA
 10+ years of experience working as part of a US Government and contractor engineering team, communicating and thinking critically about mission objectives, and identifying potential development pathways that could meet program needs
 Experience applying modern software development best practices and techniques to develop and configure software, analyze and resolve bugs and defects, and develop associated technical manuals and codebase documentation
 Experience maintaining multiple software and test equipment configurations concurrently to meet different fielded platform versions and requirements
 Experience with hardware emulation systems, test equipment, developing test hardware and software, performing testing and identifying necessary changes to production software
 Experience working in a US Government test facility, developing trusted relationships with stakeholders across an engineering team, and leading the development of production software modifications that meet mission needs
 Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Science
 
 Nice If You Have: 

 Experience with the ALE-47 Countermeasures Dispensing System
 Experience with US Navy aircraft Electronic Warfare systems
 Experience providing technical and engineering support to Foreign Military Sales operators of ALE-47 or related countermeasures or electronic warfare system equipment
 Experience designing and utilizing test equipment to program and diagnose ALE-47 system performance
 Experience creating and testing modules and components for compliance to design specifications
 Experience developing and testing interfaces between software products and products of other vendors
 Possession of professionalism, work ethic, and integrity
 Secret clearance
 
 Clearance: 
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. 
 
 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
 
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 

 Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
 Onsite : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
